trigger: A product's UX/UI must be designed end to end in confirmed phases ('design the UX/UI', 'ออกแบบ UX/UI ทั้งโปรเจกต์', uxui.md, a design system file, page or feature artifacts)
inputs: the answers to the Phase 0 brief, including references and real user data
an existing design system or framework the user names
the confirmed outputs of earlier phases
action: Run the phases in order, building uxui.md, a versioned design-system.html, and the page or feature artifacts with the Token Block, checking each with uxui-check.mjs, and stopping for CONFIRM after every phase and feature

outputs.description: uxui.md, design-system.html with a versioned Token Block, and the HTML artifacts, each ending with Design QA
the CONFIRM at the end of each phase and feature, and every missing brief answer
the phase summary, the uxui-check result, and what remains open

handoff.when: a design decision needs the principle, pattern, or verification procedure
an approved artifact must be implemented; it becomes the change's prototypeSelection
a phase or feature is ready for CONFIRM or the brief lacks an answer

aiDoes: builds the design files and keeps their Token Block versions consistent
runs uxui-check.mjs and fixes every finding
humanDoes: answers the brief and supplies references and real user data
humanDecides: style direction, tokens, and new components
